svg.title: D1 solenoid field profile
svg.desc: Axial field profile of the 42-turn solenoid and the field error inside the cell volume.
svg.text: D1 Field of the solenoid (ring-by-ring Biot–Savart calculation, free space)
Winding radius 18.9 mm. The mu-metal shield and its end caps change the absolute field (calibrate with the fluxgate) but not the winding rules.
red ρ = 0, orange ρ = 6 mm, purple ρ = 12.5 mm (cell wall)
dashed blue: 36 uniform turns at ρ = 0
Result (cell volume ρ ≤ 12.5 mm, |z| ≤ 12.5 mm): field error 0.20 % with the end turns, 0.42 % without. On the beam axis (ρ ≤ 3 mm): 0.20 %.
Allowed: 0.2 % of 50 mG = 0.1 mG, a shift of 140 Hz against the 7 kHz line.
Tilt B_ρ / B_z: 2.0 mrad from the coil length; the two return wires add about 6, 11 and 37 mrad at ρ = 3, 6 and 12.5 mm. A tilt θ changes |B| only by θ²/2: negligible.
Centre field: 3.391 mG per mA, so 50 mG needs 14.7 mA (free space). A check with the true helix and the return wires gives 0.20 % over the cell.
